description: D7's `manual` half: the person writes the size by hand and the item becomes eligible in the SAME claimed statement — range and basis present together (D8: the three fields are all-present-or-all-absent, a bare number is not expressible), status `pending` → `ready`. In `skill` mode this exact act is refused BY NAME because report_size is the only writer there (D9); a silent no-op would let the person believe their number landed. The claim rides the store's door, whose WHERE refuses if the item moved under the write.

params.sizeBasis: one handler, one store door, one blueprint hook; tests ride the existing fixture
